rule.text: Pre-registered (plan 22 must_haves, written before any training reads it): geometry trusted when auto-place precision is at least 98 percent on the gold documents and on the review sample, with no how-made kind below 95 percent; kind trusted at 98 percent kind precision; person trusted at 98 percent person precision; an untrusted part of the auto labels is not used (that target is learned only from hand and reviewed sheets); background full when proposal recall on gold is at least 97 percent, else masked (training loss on auto-labelled pages ignores everything within 24 pt of a proposal or a printed line or box that is not an accepted place); if geometry is not trusted, auto labels are not used at all. Weight 0.5 for trusted auto places.

kind.note: not used: geometry is not trusted

person.note: not used: geometry is not trusted

background.note: applies to any page whose labels are not a complete hand sheet

weight.why: auto labels are not used at all (geometry not trusted)

reviewed_disagreements_only.note: Sheets reviewed on disagreements only (auto places kept unreviewed) measured below the same 98 percent bar on 6 blind gold documents. The pre-registered rule does not name them, so the same bar is applied: they are not used as complete sheets. Later adjudication (plans 24 to 29) confirms every auto place (confirm-all) because geometry is not trusted.
